semantic_fidelity.reason: All six concepts and seven source-qualified directed relationships appear across two fully mapped views, each relation exactly once. Separate core→Redis 25 GbE and web→Redis session remain distinct. Labels retain all speeds and application meanings. No extra link, reversal, background dot, hidden qualifier, or motion-as-GbE scale is introduced. Historical relations are not promoted to independently verified network facts. Source even-split presentation evidence is separately blocked under workflow, not a missing graph relation.

arrow_traceability.reason: N01: seven static source stems and unique downward heads are clearly traceable, with zero crossings/junction ambiguity and unambiguous session/25 GbE owners. However, the frozen category expressly makes off-origin dots a direction-proof failure, so all seven edges fail this gate. Visible routes are monotone near-minimal obstacle-safe paths; no detour is observed. The absent routes diagnostic was explicitly removed from the required baseline checks and is not a new failure.

layout_fit.reason: Complete final-spec pinned 77×47 dumps have explicit viewport lines and natural 100% zoom; every box, label, arrow and palette cell fits without pan/zoom or occlusion, with zero crossings/touching bends in both views. Coverage is complete. Larger live app viewports are separately recorded as 83×51, never relabeled as target panes. The frozen metadata explicitly accepts final-spec pinned target dumps for fit when the uncontrolled live pane is larger; no validator-only fit inference is used.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Source network infrastructure WAN/Firewall/Core switch is nearby and pink; service/data tiers Web/Redis/DB are nearby and teal, with families stable across views. ANSI establishes colors. Exact RGB changes for three repeated nodes are not a separate gate. No source requirement names group blocks or group labels; their renderer absence is not a rubric defect.

border_integrity.reason: Normal and all-selected ANSI prove all 9/9 node occurrences (202 perimeter cells across the views) have all sides/corners and continuous per-node colors at measured 83×51; selected borders are uniformly RGB(216,166,87). Pinned 77×47 text independently proves complete target geometry and zero palette-overwritten node-border cells. No border defect is observed. This pass is bounded to the captured color states; absence of a target-size color-bearing capture remains an explicit workflow evidence gap N03, not an assertion of observed 77×47 selected color.

workflow_evidence.reason: N03–N06: frozen input and artifact hashes verify; distinct DeepSeek generator and Sol reviewer plus immutable blind-first record are documented. Complete target-size motion dumps exist, but target-size color states, raw command/stderr/status and cleanup probes, original overwritten first-run record, and the executed validator snapshot/version lineage are incomplete. V2 live pane frames 0–11 are missing but compensated for target motion by the complete pinned dump. No missing evidence is converted to a pass; validator PASS does not waive gaps.

animation.reason: N01 independently fails all 7 origins and check/capture agreement. N02 records five two-cell jitter routes as directional-flow legibility defects. Exactly one dot per route, no label overlap, and full target-size laps are evidenced. Shared nominal 0.5c/step cadence is legal; unequal 400/2200/2600ms lap times and absence of head contact in constant mode are not same-arrival failures. Two long routes skip non-origin corners, which avoids prohibited corner rests and is not separately penalized; the corner jump limits literal grid-speed inference but cannot rescue failed origins.

findings.description: [defect] Every frame-0 dot is on the SECOND drawn corridor cell after its source-border port, one cell past the FIRST drawn cell required by revision 6. The first cell remains an unoccupied vertical stem throughout the laps. All seven origins fail, while the check claims 7/7 in aggregate; capture and check disagree. This independently fails animation and, by the explicit rubric origin clause, arrow_traceability, even though static arrowheads and endpoints are readable.

[defect: directional-motion legibility] Five required animated links have only two occupied positions: hold at position A for 200ms, one cell down to B for 200ms, then jump back up every 400ms. The blind review and generator disclosure independently identify jitter rather than readable sustained traffic flow. This is a localized failure of the source-requested slow directional motion, not a demand for synchronized arrival or a numeric GbE-rate encoding. It does not negate correct static endpoints or create a semantic relation failure.

[evidence gap] Target-size captures are text-only. Normal and selected ANSI prove colors at measured 83x51, not 77x47. The 77x47 pinned full laps prove target geometry, but there is no color-bearing normal/selected target capture or live target-size pane. The generator explicitly reports its live target-size capability limitation. These are not inferred target border defects; they block complete target-state workflow verification.

[evidence gap] Full raw command/status provenance is incomplete: draft checks contain stdout but no retained exit status or separated stderr; commands use candidate placeholders and v2 exact capture invocation is not fully recorded; original abandoned first-run output was overwritten and replaced by a disclosed re-run; five manually opened probe panes have only narrative cleanup assurances, not raw launch/close/probe records. Final-pane manifests record confirmed_closed but no verbatim close result. The even-split source request cannot be independently checked from a preserved pane rectangle or split transcript. Do not infer leaks or wrong split ratios from this absence.

Narrative v2 advance/pane proofs in generation.json cite unavailable frame 0 or coordinates not matching the retained captures; use the independently enumerated raw pinned coordinates instead. This is not evidence of missing motion frames at the target size.
